note: Files scripts/check_no_pii.py cannot read (binary content, or a compressed file it cannot decompress).
A scanner that cannot read a file reports it clean unless that file is registered here, so this list is the
only silence that is a verdict. Every entry needs reason, reviewed_by and reviewed_at: the reviewer states
what the file is and why it carries no personal or identifying data. An entry is a reviewed decision, not a
mute. Add one only after opening the file; never add one to make the gate green.
Render with scripts/lib/ci_gates.render(); a test asserts this file is its canonical rendering.
